title: A deformability-based biochip for precise label-free stratification of metastatic subtypes using deep learning.
summary: Yolov5, Deep SORT and ResUNet++ detect, track and segment cells to quantify deformability in a microfluidic assay. The source reports cell-line classification and pre/post-hypoxia comparisons; evidence is in vitro and does not establish patient-level diagnosis. The study does not establish external generalization, causal effects or sustained operational impact.
